Chapter 770: Chapter 1 Inventory Gains (Subscribe Requested)_3

Chapter 770: Chapter 1 Inventory Gains (Subscribe Requested)_3

Observing every aspect of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, Lin Yuan had developed a concrete approach to the opening of the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

“Physical body!”

“Soul!”

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly.

The physical body and soul were the foundations of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path. Starting from the Fourth Rank Fifth Stage Section, Lin Yuan’s opened Martial Path Evolutionary Path had focused on the Understanding of Rules and the development of the Inner World.

But by the Tenth Rank Chapter, Lin Yuan’s attention returned to the physical body and soul.

...

With many special lifeforms among the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses as references, Lin Yuan gained a whole new level of understanding concerning the minute structure of the physical body and the essence of the soul.

In terms of foundational aspects, human civilization indeed fell far short in comparison to those special lifeforms with profound heritages.

Starting behind didn’t mean always being behind. Lin Yuan’s newly developed Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter was rapidly absorbing the strengths of these special lifeforms.

Theoretically, if the Tenth Rank Chapter opened up by Lin Yuan was cultivated by future Martial Arts Evolutionaries, they would be no weaker than those special lifeforms in all aspects.

…

Lin Yuan’s observation of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses in terms of their physical bodies, souls, and Understanding of Rules, even memories, was not only a great help in perfecting the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

It was also incredibly beneficial for himself.

Lin Yuan’s physical body slowly evolved towards the utmost level of perfection, and the understanding of many rules, especially the pillar-level Fusion Rules, was rapidly improving.

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, two months had passed.

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted as he looked towards a floating silver mirror nearby.

“Finally, the initial refining is successful,” Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

This supreme weapon, the silver mirror, had no owner from the start. Moreover, Lin Yuan infused it with his mental power continuously in the Two-dimensional World.

From the time he began until now with the initial refining success, he had encountered virtually no setbacks or obstructions.

Whirrrr.

After the initial refining of the silver mirror, Lin Yuan’s consciousness entered the world contained within it.

Boom Boom Boom.

Within the Two-dimensional World, the interior world of the silver mirror was nothing more than a cramped space of ten square meters.

But at this moment.

As Lin Yuan’s consciousness merged with it, he was immediately stunned.

A world vast and boundless presented itself before Lin Yuan.

“The size of this space is at least ten thousand light-years in diameter, isn’t it?” Lin Yuan muttered to himself, but by size, the Inner Universe of a Supreme Being seemed to be about the same size.

“Such a massive world, once fully activated, would be no less than a Supreme Being making a full-powered effort,” Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

However, to fully activate the silver mirror, one would have to be a Supreme Being. Even if Lin Yuan stepped into Tier 11, he would at best barely activate it, let alone fully activate it? Probably far from it.

“Let’s check the other exotic treasures.”

Lin Yuan followed his senses to a vast stone platform.

A variety of exotic treasures were placed there. Upon a closer count, the total number of exotic treasures exceeded a hundred.

As he left the Two-dimensional World, the silver mirror began to revive, and these exotic treasures gradually recovered as well.

If this were not in the world inside the silver mirror but in the Main Universe, the fluctuations emitted by these more than a hundred ‘exotic treasures’ would likely affect tens to hundreds of thousands of light-years.

“Eleven of these exotic treasures belong to human civilization,” Lin Yuan identified, selecting them from over a hundred items.

During ten thousand years in the Two-dimensional World, Xuanyuan Dua and many other human civilization evolutionaries had been continuously searching for many rare treasures, handing over a total of twenty-two to Lin Yuan.

According to the agreement between Lin Yuan and the Xia Qin Supreme Being, Lin Yuan could keep half of these twenty-two treasures after taking them out.

“So many exotic treasures…”

Lin Yuan looked at the nearly hundred remaining treasures with exhilaration.

Even ultimate beings would probably be green with envy at the sight of so many exotic treasures.

“Stay calm, stay calm.”

Lin Yuan composed himself. These treasures were precious, but their practical use to him at the moment was limited.

After all, the Life Level of Lin Yuan was still too low to fully utilize these treasures.

“Take it slow.”

Lin Yuan carefully transferred the eleven exotic treasures of human civilization into his Inner World.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly; the eleven exotic treasures, eleven Twelve-Star Strange Treasures, their power completely contained, were floating quietly in his Inner World.

“I’ll take these treasures to Xia Qin Supreme Being.”

Lin Yuan placed these eleven treasures separately within his Inner World, while the silver mirror and many other treasures were stored in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

After doing all this, the Taiyang Divine Spirit left the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was seated cross-legged when a figure silently appeared before him.

It was none other than the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

“You’re back?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

“The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being has been waiting for me for some time now,” Lin Yuan’s heart stirred as the Taiyang Divine Spirit left the Milky Way Main Star, heading towards a patch of starry sky.

Days before, an incarnation of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being had appeared outside the Milky Way Main Star, ensuring that nothing untoward befell Lin Yuan.

After all, Lin Yuan was the only survivor from the White Paper of all the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses. Although other different species weren’t aware of this, human civilization had to be cautious.

“Thank you, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.”

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit flew out and bowed slightly to the ethereal figure in the starry sky.

“No trouble at all,” said the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being with a smile, her voice soft, “Shall I take you to our human civilization’s third stronghold? The other Supreme Beings want to meet you.”

“The Supreme Beings?” Lin Yuan looked slightly puzzled.

“Yes, Xia Qin and the other seven all want to meet you,” the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan.

“Eight Supreme Beings?” Lin Yuan held his breath. If you add the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being in front of him, that would be nine Supreme Beings.

Nine Supreme Beings of human civilization showing up just to meet him?

Such an event was rare; unless faced with a crisis of survival, human civilization’s nine Supreme Beings seldom gathered together as most of them had their endeavors to pursue.
